centralized_log_aggregation.title: Centralized Log Aggregation
centralized_log_aggregation.description: True when logs from logging-capable assets are forwarded into one central SIEM/data lake, establishing the correlation substrate so no single source is the only copy and cross-source analysis is possible.

required_log_source_classes_onboarded.title: Required Log Source Classes Onboarded
required_log_source_classes_onboarded.description: True when every in-scope logging-capable asset class (host/EDR, network, identity/IdP, cloud, application) is actively forwarding to the central platform with fresh last-seen timestamps. An un-onboarded class is a silent blind spot through which a multi-step attack escapes detection.

logs_stored_on_separate_system.title: Logs Stored on Separate System
logs_stored_on_separate_system.description: True when the aggregated correlation substrate is stored on a system separate from the monitored assets, so an attacker who compromises a source cannot erase its own copy of the multi-step trail. Contextual to centralization here and load-bearing in the retention facet.

cross_source_correlation_enabled.title: Cross-Source Correlation Enabled
cross_source_correlation_enabled.description: Attests that enabled correlation rules stitch events ACROSS multiple repositories/source classes (identity/IdP, host/EDR, network, cloud) rather than evaluating each source in isolation — the cross-datamodel substrate without which a multi-step chain spanning sources is never linked.

multistage_incident_correlation_enabled.title: Multi-Stage Incident Correlation Enabled
multistage_incident_correlation_enabled.description: Attests that at least one enabled multi-datamodel correlation rule exists per major attack chain (lateral movement, C2, credential access) that links sequential stages into a SINGLE incident object, surfacing multi-stage chains invisible to any single-source rule.

detection_rules_attack_mapped.title: Detection Rules ATT&CK-Mapped
detection_rules_attack_mapped.description: Attested true when every enabled detection/correlation rule is tagged with one or more MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs, so coverage can be quantified per technique rather than assumed.

attack_coverage_measured_and_trended.title: ATT&CK Coverage Measured and Trended
attack_coverage_measured_and_trended.description: Attested true when an ATT&CK Navigator-style coverage heatmap is maintained and trended over time (% of in-scope techniques with at least one tested detection), with zero-coverage techniques tracked to closure.

attack_technique_coverage_pct.title: ATT&CK Technique Coverage Percentage
attack_technique_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of in-scope MITRE ATT&CK techniques that have at least one tested detection. The protection is effective when this meets or exceeds the minimum coverage threshold (>= 80%).

ueba_anomaly_analytics_enabled.title: UEBA Anomaly Analytics Enabled
ueba_anomaly_analytics_enabled.description: User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) is enabled, modeling normal user and entity activity and scoring deviations to complement static correlation rules and catch novel and credential-abuse attacks that signatures miss.

entity_baseline_trained.title: Entity Baseline Trained
entity_baseline_trained.description: Behavioral baselines of normal per-user and per-entity activity have been trained and are active, so the analytics has a learned reference against which to flag deviations rather than running against an empty or cold model.

baseline_training_window_days.title: Baseline Training Window (Days)
baseline_training_window_days.description: Length in days of the activity window over which the behavioral baseline is trained. A sufficiently long window (>= 14 days) is required for the learned normal profile to be statistically meaningful rather than overfit to a short sample.

impossible_travel_detection_enabled.title: Impossible-Travel Detection Enabled
impossible_travel_detection_enabled.description: Geolocation-based impossible-travel logon detection is enabled — successive authentications from geographically distant locations within a physically impossible interval are flagged (D3FEND D3-UGLPA), surfacing valid-account abuse and credential theft.

authentication_thresholding_enabled.title: Authentication Thresholding Enabled
authentication_thresholding_enabled.description: Authentication-event thresholding/anomaly analysis is enabled — abnormal volumes or patterns of authentication events (failed-logon spikes, off-baseline access patterns) are detected, complementing static rules to catch brute-force and credential-reuse attacks.

detection_as_code_version_controlled.title: Detection-as-Code Version Controlled
detection_as_code_version_controlled.description: True when correlation/detection content (e.g. Sigma rules) is authored and maintained in a version-control system rather than hand-edited directly in the SIEM console, providing change history, auditability, and rollback (CM-2/CM-3).

detection_content_peer_reviewed.title: Detection Content Peer Reviewed
detection_content_peer_reviewed.description: True when changes to detection content are merged only through peer-reviewed pull requests (required reviewer approval), enforcing the change-control review gate (CM-3) so no rule reaches production unreviewed.

detection_content_ci_tested.title: Detection Content CI Tested
detection_content_ci_tested.description: True when detection content passes automated CI/CD testing — syntax validation, unit tests, and integration tests against sample telemetry — before deployment, so broken or non-firing rules are caught pre-release rather than silently losing coverage.

detection_content_update_cadence_days.title: Detection Content Update Cadence (Days)
detection_content_update_cadence_days.description: Maximum number of days between scheduled refreshes of detection content against evolving TTPs (vendor content packs, community Sigma, new CVEs). The protection is present when the cadence is at most a defined threshold (e.g. 90 days). Stale, frozen rules silently lose coverage as attackers shift.

clocks_synced_to_trusted_time_source.title: Clocks Synced to Trusted Time Source
clocks_synced_to_trusted_time_source.description: All log-producing sources synchronize their clocks to at least two approved/trusted NTP time sources, so emitted event timestamps share a common, drift-bounded reference. When false, clock drift mis-orders the events of an attack chain and makes cross-source correlation unreliable.

timestamps_in_utc.title: Timestamps Normalized to UTC at Ingest
timestamps_in_utc.description: Ingested event timestamps from every source are normalized to a single canonical timezone (UTC) at ingest, eliminating mixed-timezone skew so multi-stage correlation can order events across sources deterministically.

threat_intel_enrichment_enabled.title: Threat-Intel Enrichment Enabled
threat_intel_enrichment_enabled.description: Attests that events and entities are enriched at ingest/correlation time with threat intelligence (known-bad IP/domain/file-hash indicators) and asset/identity context, so matches against known-bad observables and asset criticality feed the correlation and scoring layer.

risk_based_alerting_enabled.title: Risk-Based Alerting Enabled
risk_based_alerting_enabled.description: Attests that the platform assigns risk scores to enriched events/entities and raises an investigative notable only when accumulated risk crosses a defined threshold (AU-6(5)), rather than emitting one alert per rule firing — so multi-step chains are scored, prioritized, and surfaced as a single accumulated-risk notable.

alert_tuning_process_enabled.title: Alert Tuning Process Enabled
alert_tuning_process_enabled.description: Attests that an ongoing alert/false-positive tuning process exists (threshold review, suppression of benign-true patterns, periodic precision review) so the risk-based alerting layer stays effective over time and real correlated incidents are not buried in fatigue.

alert_response_sla_enforced.title: Alert Response SLA Enforced
alert_response_sla_enforced.description: Surfaced notable incidents auto-route to the IR queue and are governed by a defined, enforced response-time SLA (IR-4/IR-5), so detections trigger timely response and measurably reduce attacker dwell time rather than sitting unactioned.

soar_response_handoff_enabled.title: SOAR Response Handoff Enabled
soar_response_handoff_enabled.description: Correlated incidents auto-route into the SOAR / IR ticketing workflow (case creation, orchestration, playbook handoff) instead of remaining as console-only alerts, closing the detection-to-response loop.

audit_log_tamper_evident.title: Audit Log Tamper-Evident
audit_log_tamper_evident.description: The correlated-event substrate (centralized log/SIEM store) is integrity-protected via write-once / cryptographic tamper-evidence and access-restricted (AU-9(2)/(3)/(4)), so an attacker who reaches the SIEM cannot silently erase or alter the multi-step trail.

log_retention_days.title: Log Retention (Days)
log_retention_days.description: Number of days correlated events are retained hot/online. Protection is present when retention is at least 90 days (CIS 8.10), so slow, multi-month campaigns can still be reconstructed from the substrate.
